Failover routing to Maximum wait time reached

Format `header:record_id`, where `header` is `account` (a sub-account, from getSubAccounts), `fwd` (a forwarding, from getForwardings), `vm` (a voicemail, from getVoicemails), `sip`, `grp`, `ivr`, `sys`, `recording`, `queue`, `cb`, `tc`, `disa` or `none`. `sys` takes `hangup` (hang up the call), `busy` (busy tone), `noservice` (number not in service recording), `disconnected` (number disconnected recording), `dtmf` (DTMF test) or `echo` (sound quality test), and `none` takes no record id.
